# Learned evaluation framework

## Framework and installed version

- Framework and package: AgentEvals, npm package `agentevals`, whose strict trajectory matcher `evaluator/trajectory.mjs` calls.
- Installed package and version: `agentevals@0.0.7`, the version `evaluator/frameworks.json` declares and `tea-evaluate run` observes before each launch of the evaluator.
- Model and credentials needed: none; the assertions or the matcher are deterministic.

An upgrade of the package updates this record and `evaluator/frameworks.json` together.
